parsed.explanation: Combined regime: no adult presentation offence or state-wide adult facility ban in this division, and existing X passports remain valid, but national passport/entry, federal-facility, custody and minor-care rules create documented traveller-facing exposures. Entry discrepancy can trigger refusal and fraud consideration; federal single-sex facilities are restricted; national custody reports include hormone removal and abuse; the division bans school bathrooms by birth sex, school sport for trans girls, and gender-affirming care for minors without phase-out. Municipal protections in 19 places and federal hate-crime/employment law provide patchy, litigated recourse, offset by state hate-crime exclusion of gender identity and a religious-freedom override route. For adults the main risk is conditional/outings at borders and federal sites; for travelling minors, care and school exposures are direct.

entry_documents.exposure: National X-marker issuance stopped Feb 2025, existing X valid to expiry; reported confiscations/blocking; entry cable directs refusal and fraud/permanent-ineligibility consideration where documents cast doubt on sex.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports remain valid until expiration; permanent ineligibility is not automatic and requires four elements; passport policy is under litigation.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy can escalate from entry questioning to refusal/fraud allegation, then to detention placement risks.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections bureau from 2026 adopted conversion-therapy model including hormone removal; immigration-custody reports of forced labour, beatings, solitary and sexual abuse; arrest example held trans woman in men's ward 24h.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. No division-specific custody placement protection is documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Any arrest, e.g. trespass-based facility charge elsewhere or immigration detention, risks birth-sex/harmful custody with stopped reporting of trans prisoners.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National order bars trans people from government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity; division bans birth-sex bathrooms for K-12 students only, no adult state-wide rule documented; 4 states criminalise in some circumstances.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 33 states/district have no mapped ban; in this division no adult ban documented, and 19 municipalities cover public accommodations.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Adult visitor may be safe in most state/private facilities but exposed in federal buildings and, for a minor, in public schools.

care_services.exposure: Division bans puberty blockers/hormones for minors from July 2023, no phase-out for existing patients; national orders target minor gender-affirming care and funding.
care_services.protection: No adult care ban documented. Conversion therapy on minors illegal division-wide since Sept 2024.
care_services.interaction: Adult visitor care access not documented as restricted; travelling minor needing continuing hormones/blockers faces denial/interruption in this division.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National counterterrorism strategy prioritises 'radically pro-transgender' violent groups; 2025 orders direct investigation/prosecution over school social transition; officials frame trans participation as threat.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Several 2025 orders blocked/enjoined or in litigation; national hate-crime statute covers gender identity; no trans presentation offence documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Hostile state framing raises outing/investigation risk without making adult presence per se criminal in this division.

minors_guardians.exposure: School bathroom restriction by birth sex, 2022 school-sport ban for trans girls, minor care ban; national order threatens teachers who facilitate social transition.
minors_guardians.protection: Parents sued care ban; conversion-therapy ban protects minors; municipal ordinances in 19 places.
minors_guardians.interaction: Guardian travelling with minor faces school, sport and care barriers if enrolling or seeking treatment; non-resident short visit reduces school exposure but not care ban.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: State hate-crime statute covers sexual orientation but expressly excludes gender identity; religious-freedom statute can override local non-discrimination ordinances; no trans-specific violence statistics documented.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Federal hate-crime law covers gender identity; 2011 sexual-orientation beating led to arrests/guilty pleas; 19 municipal ordinances.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Patchy local recourse means service refusal or assault remedy depends on municipality and federal action.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport, executive-order and care-ban litigation unresolved; enforcement of school bathroom rule not quantified; adult facility and custody outcomes in division not documented.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Civil-liberties suit on passports, injunctions on some orders, appellate employment protection, municipal recourse.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies exist but are contested and uneven, so they do not reliably cancel documented national or minor-specific exposures.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower than 0.45-A on adult facilities: that anchor has an unremedied all-government-building adult bathroom ban; here adult ban is federal-only plus K-12 in this division, so adult exposure is narrower.
Higher than 0.35-C: no documented routine police stops, photographing/extortion of trans visitors in this division; entry risk is document-based and litigated, not organised street targeting.

Similar to 0.55-B: repeated/patchy service friction and incomplete remedies without a universal adult ban, but national custody/care harms and minor bans pull slightly below its primarily local, partially remedied pattern.

Lower than 0.65-C: that anchor has dead-letter sexuality law, accepted documents and court compensation; here passport restriction, federal facilities, custody harms and minor care ban are active, not dead-letter.

parsed.synthesis: Interaction drives the score: home documents determine entry/federal-facility treatment, and an outing can move to investigation, refusal or custody where documented harms are severe but conditional. In this division adult everyday facilities/services are not state-wide banned and municipal/federal protections give some recourse, preventing a 0.35 rating. That is outweighed for minors by direct school and care bans, and for all visitors by national document, federal-facility and custody exposures with contested, patchy remedies, placing the combined regime at the elevated-risk midpoint.
